definitions: To clean and brush (an animal, especially a horse).
To give a neat and tidy appearance to (someone).
To prepare or train (someone) for a particular purpose or position.
To prepare (oneself) for a particular event or occasion.
To prepare a child or vulnerable person for sexual abuse, typically by befriending them or their family and gaining their trust.
examples: She spent an hour grooming the horse.
He groomed himself carefully for the interview.
The company grooms its employees for leadership roles.
The predator groomed the child online.
